notes.title: Ren'Py Threat or Error Pop-up
notes.content:
Hi there!

We've been made aware of the reoccurring issue for some players. When launching My Sweet! Housemate, some players may encounter a pop-up that falsely identifies the game as a threat or produces an error message.

We've found that this is caused by Microsoft no longer recognising the new build of Ren'Py (the engine My Sweet! Housemate uses) as a safe program. Ren'Py Tom (the creator of the engine) has already requested a change from Microsoft, but it will take some time for it to go through. https://github.com/renpy/renpy/issues/6089


We've made a list of temporary solutions that may work for some people:

1. Make sure your Windows Defender is updated to the latest version. You can find out how to on this page: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/wdsi/defenderupdates


2. Try uninstalling and reinstalling the game. We've rolled back the patch with the newest build of Ren'Py, so reinstalling the 2.0 build might resolve the issue. Don't worry - all your progress is safe as it is stored in a separate folder.

3. If the above does not work, you can try creating an exclusion for My Sweet! Housemate folder in your Windows Defender. 

You can create an exclusion by following these steps:
[olist]
[*] Go to Start > Settings > Update & Security > Windows Security > Virus & threat protection.
[*] Under "Virus & threat protection settings" select "Manage settings".
Under "Exclusions" select "Add or remove exclusions".
[*] Select "Add an exclusion" and "Folder"
[*]You can find the folder in "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\My Sweet! Housemate". 
[/olist]

We are closely following the news and will roll out a new patch as soon as possible. We appreciate everyone who brought our attention to this issue and will keep you all updated!

notes.title: 🥩My Sweet! Housemate - 2.0🥩
notes.content:
[h3]Long Time No See![/h3]
Hello everyone! We're happy to announce the latest update for My Sweet! Housemate, version 2.0. 

This update is essentially a rework of MS!H, including things like sprite updates, UI changes, new minigames, new endings, and more bloodshed.
 
Thank you to everyone who's followed the progress of [b]My Sweet! Housemate[/b] - your support has kept us going. We've worked really hard on this update and are excited to hear your feedback!

[h3]🥩New Update - My Sweet! Update 2.0🥩[/h3]

🧅 SPRITE UPDATE! Now Seung-min looks more delicious than ever!
🥕 Freshened up the writing.
🥩 +3 hot new tracks fresh out of the oven.
🧅 +6 new achievements. Grab 'em while they're hot! 
🥕 +3 new endings.
🥩 3+ thousand new words.
🧅 Added a clock. Now you can tell time!
🥕 Added some funny sounds. Can you find them?
🥩 Added some graphical changes. Old CGIs are now improved, among other modifications such as UI improvements, and gallery additions.
🧅 Added new interactions. Oink oink.
🥕 Added a new minigame and updated pre-existing minigames. Have fun!
🥩And more!

You can find some of the changes and additions in the updated trailer and screenshots on the store page.
Thank you all very much for playing [b]My Sweet! Housemate[/b]. We hope to see you all again soon! ❤️

For the full list of updates, check our website: https://www.sourmilkgames.com/updates-msh

Consider leaving a review - it helps us a lot!

notes.title: 🥩New Update - New endings & content!🥩
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, tasty treats![/h1]

[h2]We're back at it again with another update for My Sweet! Housemate. [/h2]

[h3]Here's a list of all the fresh new ingredients we've sprinkled into the coding soup: [/h3]

🧅 Added 2 additional endings.

🥕 Added an unlockable art gallery, along with more artwork.

🥩 Added 3 new achievements. 

🥕 Added a dash of horror.

🥩 Added an extra soundtrack.

🧅 Improved GUI's flavor.

🥕 Added an extra serving of humor.

This concludes the most recent update of My Sweet! Housemate. Dinner is served, y'all. 

If you're struggling to get all of the achievements and endings, you can check our [url=https://my-sweet-housemate.fandom.com/wiki/My_Sweet!_Housemate_Wiki]Fandom Wiki[/url] for very useful guides.
[h3]
Thank you all for playing My Sweet! Housemate, and for supporting us! We love seeing your reactions and feedback. ❤️[/h3]
